summary: Ucommune International Ltd filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a current report on Form 8-K) announcing an extraordinary general meeting (US equivalent: special shareholder meeting) set for November 9, 2026 Beijing time, with a record date of October 8, 2026. The meeting seeks approval for a reverse share split contingent on a sub-US$1.00 bid price for three consecutive trading days, with ratios from 10:1 down to 2:1 selected to preserve at least 500,000 publicly held shares, plus a corresponding authorized share capital increase to 1,000,000,000 shares. No board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are stated. Watch for Nasdaq minimum-bid compliance and delisting risk.
